summary_en: BCJ-116, a special purpose vehicle backed by Bain Capital Private Equity, launched a tender offer for all shares of Hokuriku Electric Industry at 4,180 yen per share, with a minimum purchase threshold of 5,232,600 shares representing 67.13% ownership on a fully diluted basis. The board endorsed the offer and recommended shareholders tender their shares.
title_en: Notice of Expression of Opinion in Support of and Recommendation to Tender Shares in Public Tender Offer for the Company's Shares by BCJ-116 Corp.
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, the board of Hokuriku Electric Industry endorsed a tender offer by BCJ-116 Corporation for all outstanding shares of the company at a price of 4,180 yen per share. BCJ-116 is a special purpose vehicle established on October 21, 2026 as a wholly-owned subsidiary of BCJ-115, which is indirectly controlled by Bain Capital Private Equity, LP, an international investment firm with approximately 225 billion dollars under management globally. The bidder currently holds no shares of the company.

The tender offer is scheduled to run for 30 business days from November 11 through December 23, 2026. The offer contains a minimum tender condition requiring acceptance of at least 5,232,600 shares. If this minimum threshold is met, the bidder's post-acquisition shareholding would reach 67.13% on a fully diluted basis, calculated using 77,944 total voting rights as of March 31, 2026 disclosed in the company's latest securities report filed on June 25, 2026. The board's decision to support the offer and recommend shareholder participation was made on the explicit premise that the tender offer would proceed toward the target company becoming a wholly-owned subsidiary of the bidder, with anticipated delisting from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.

The board resolution approving support for the offer was adopted with the unanimous consent of all directors without conflicts of interest, including audit committee members, as part of measures designed to ensure fairness and protection of minority shareholders in the transaction.
